name: Medusa's Wrath
prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, Gorgon's Fist, Scorpion Style, base attack bonus +11
benefit:
Whenever you use the full-attack action and make at least one unarmed strike, you can make two additional unarmed strikes at your highest base attack bonus. These bonus attacks must be made against a dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foe.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 126
While using this feat, you can spend 10 stamina points to make the bonus attacks against a foe that you are flanking, instead of only a dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foe.
flavor: You can take advantage of your opponent's confusion, delivering multiple blows.
